title: iTutorGroup to Pay $365000 to Settle EEOC Discriminatory Hiring Suit
supports_claim: EEOC reported a $365000 settlement and more than 200 automatically rejected older applicants.
limitations: Settlement announcement describes allegations and relief; it does not publish a technical model audit.

title: Navigating Employment Discrimination in AI and Automated Systems - Testimony of Gary D. Friedman
supports_claim: Testimony records the reported Amazon recruitment prototype history and cautions that iTutorGroup may have been rule-based automation rather than AI.
limitations: Witness testimony is not an EEOC adjudicative finding and cites external reporting for Amazon.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
supports_claim: NIST organizes voluntary AI risk management around Govern Map Measure and Manage.
limitations: Voluntary framework; not a legal classification or certification.

title: Law 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: Vietnam AI Law took effect on 2026-03-01 and establishes the governing legal scope.
limitations: Exact obligations depend on role use case and implementing instruments.

title: Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg high-risk AI list
supports_claim: The decision publishes Vietnam's list of high-risk AI systems and took effect on 2026-08-15.
limitations: A use case must be matched to the full official list; title metadata alone is insufficient for classification.

title: EU AI Act implementation timeline
supports_claim: The Commission identifies employment as a high-risk area and publishes the current staged application timeline.
limitations: Implementation dates and guidance can change; re-check before deployment.
